tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a visible, in-stock simple product to the current Magento shopping cart by exact SKU. Products requiring configuration must be configured on their product page.

tools.name: get_checkout_details
tools.description: Read the current shopping cart totals, items, selected shipping method, and checkout readiness. This tool does not place an order or change checkout data.

tools.name: get_my_order
tools.description: Get the logged-in customer's order with the supplied order number. If no order number is supplied, get the customer's most recent order. Never use this for another customer.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the HorecaGrootkeukenShop catalog by product name, keywords, or exact SKU. Use this before adding a product when the SKU or product type is uncertain.

query.description: Product name, keywords, or an exact SKU.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.
